name: How do I choose the right contractor for my low threshold shower project?

mainEntity.name: How do I choose the right contractor for my low threshold shower project?

acceptedAnswer.text: When selecting a contractor for your low threshold shower, look for experience specifically with this type of installation, as it requires specialized knowledge in waterproofing and drainage. Check their portfolio for similar projects and read customer reviews to gauge their quality of work and reliability. Ensure they are licensed, insured, and willing to provide a detailed proposal outlining the scope of work, materials, and timeline. A good contractor will also be transparent about the permitting process and able to offer design advice.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose a contractor with specific experience in low threshold installations, strong references, proper licensing and insurance, and transparent communication regarding scope and permits.
